paper.title: Shared Context, Separate Engines: Streaming Vision--Language Inference on Edge SoCs
paper.abstract: Edge SoCs pack CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs, yet vision--language model (VLM) runtimes keep generation on one engine and leave the others idle. Streaming VLMs expose further parallelism: new frames arrive while earlier queries are still being answered. Engines differ in compute and memory access and contend when they co-run, so no single placement of stages wins across SoCs and workloads. Backend-local KV state keeps other engines from continuing the work. \name coordinates heterogeneous accelerators to execute stateful VLM inference concurrently. It separates a stream's versioned context from each engine's KV state, so any engine can continue the stream by reusing, importing, or reconstructing that state. Stateful Streaming Generation ingests new frames on one engine while another answers, and Concurrent Sequence Generation serves different ready requests in parallel. State-aware dispatch sends each request to the engine expected to finish it first. Each answer reads a fixed, published version of its history and matches its serial reference. \name beats the strongest single-engine baselines on Apple M4 Max, Rockchip RK3588, and Qualcomm QCS6490, even when they reuse context. On two RK3588 video streams, it delivers $19.6\%$ more throughput than the best single engine with context reuse and $27.2\%$ more than parallel engines without shared state. Cross-engine KV import cuts first-token latency by a factor of $4.6$ over prefix recomputation. Stateful Streaming Generation delivers up to $2.48\times$ the throughput of serial execution, and state-aware dispatch cuts query completion time by up to $72.7\%$.

screening.short_summary_zh: 基于题名与摘要：论文提出一个名为\name的系统，用于在异构边缘SoC上并发执行有状态视觉-语言模型（VLM）推理。关键是将流的版本化上下文与每个引擎的本地KV状态分离，支持跨引擎重用、导入或重构状态，从而并行处理不同帧與请求。系统包含Stateful Streaming Generation、Concurrent Sequence Generation与state-aware dispatch等技术，在多款实际SoC上显著提升吞吐与降低首令牌延迟。
screening.short_summary_en: Based on title and abstract: the paper introduces a system (named in abstract) that coordinates heterogeneous accelerators on edge SoCs to run stateful vision–language model inference concurrently. It separates a stream’s versioned context from each engine’s local KV state so engines can reuse/import/reconstruct state; introduces State-aware dispatch and streaming/concurrent generation techniques; reports throughput and latency gains across Apple, Rockchip and Qualcomm SoCs.
screening.why_interesting_zh: 显著相关：它处理跨加速器并发、有状态推理、版本化上下文与跨-engine状态迁移，這些问题与MPC/secure-LLM推理中的跨主机状态管理、延迟优化与资源分配高度相近（基于题名与摘要）。
screening.why_interesting_en: Highly relevant: addresses concurrent execution of stateful inference across heterogeneous engines, versioned context separation, cross-engine KV import — concerns that map closely to secure/ML-inference runtimes where state movement, latency, and heterogeneous resources matter (title+abstract).
screening.relation_to_my_work_zh: 直接可借鉴于安全LLM推理或MP-SPDZ风格的分布式 MPC 运行时：状态版本化、跨节点/引擎KV导入、延迟-吞吐的调度策略都是可移植的设计点（基于题名与摘要）。
screening.relation_to_my_work_en: Directly applicable to secure LLM inference and MPC runtimes: techniques for versioned context, cross-engine KV import, state-aware dispatch and concurrent sequence generation could inform protocol/runtime design to reduce WAN latency and improve resource utilization (title+abstract only).
screening.possible_transfer_zh: 可移植点包括：1) 将版本化上下文抽象应用于分布式MPC/secure inference以支持故障转移与迁移；2) 基于预计完成时间的调度（state-aware dispatch）可用于网络延迟敏感的MPC作业分配；3) 跨节点KV导入可替代代价高昂的前缀重算或全部重传。

Evaluation needed under MPC cost models and security constraints.
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_zh: 与已有的分布式推理与模型并行工作可能有方法学相似处；但摘要未提及加密或MPC，因此在安全假设上可能不同，需要注意不能直接移植而不验证安全/正确性。
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_en: May overlap with heterogeneous inference and model-parallel runtimes; since abstract does not address cryptographic guarantees, direct adoption into MPC requires careful security/accounting—no explicit conflict but caution needed (title+abstract only).

deep_analysis.research_problem_zh: （仅基于题目与摘要）如何在边缘SoC上并行利用异构加速器执行状态化的视觉-语言流式推理：解决每个后端的本地KV状态阻塞、引擎性能与共享内存争用差异，以及当新帧到达且先前查询仍在执行时的并发性利用问题。
deep_analysis.research_problem_en: (Based only on title and abstract) How to concurrently utilize heterogeneous accelerators on edge SoCs for stateful streaming vision–language model (VLM) inference, addressing per-backend local KV state blocking, differing compute/memory characteristics and co-run contention, while preserving serial correctness of stream histories.
deep_analysis.core_method_zh: 将流的版本化上下文与每个引擎的本地KV状态分离；允许任一引擎通过重用、导入或重构该版本化上下文继续执行流。引入Stateful Streaming Generation与Concurrent Sequence Generation两类并发执行模式，并基于对完成时间的预计进行状态感知调度；使用固定发布的历史版本以保证串行参考一致性。
deep_analysis.core_method_en: Separate a stream’s versioned context from engine-local KV state so any engine can continue a stream by reusing, importing, or reconstructing that state. Introduce Stateful Streaming Generation and Concurrent Sequence Generation execution modes, and a state-aware dispatch that routes requests to the engine expected to finish them first. Each response reads a fixed published version of its history to match a serial reference.
contributions_zh: 提出将流的版本化上下文与各引擎本地KV分离以解除引擎间阻塞，支持跨引擎的KV导入/重用/重构。
定义并实现兩種并发执行策略：Stateful Streaming Generation（在一个引擎摄取新帧同时另一个解答）与Concurrent Sequence Generation（并行服务不同已就绪请求）。
提出基于预计完成时间的状态感知调度，将请求分派给最可能先完成的引擎。
在多款边缘SoC（Apple M4 Max、Rockchip RK3588、Qualcomm QCS6490）上实证性能提升：跨引擎KV导入将首令牌延迟降低4.6倍；在某些场景下吞吐提升至2.48×，查询完成时间最大降低72.7%。
contributions_en: Separate versioned stream context from engine-local KV and enable cross-engine KV reuse/import/reconstruction.
Define Stateful Streaming Generation (ingest new frames on one engine while another answers) and Concurrent Sequence Generation (serve different ready requests in parallel).
Introduce state-aware dispatch that sends each request to the engine expected to finish first.

Empirical evaluation on multiple edge SoCs showing significant first-token latency and throughput improvements (e.g., 4.6× reduction in first-token latency for cross-engine import, up to 2.48× throughput for Stateful Streaming Generation).
deep_analysis.why_watch_zh: 摘要中提出的状态分离、跨引擎KV导入与基于完成时间的调度是运行时/编译器级依赖感知调度、流水线并行和延迟隐藏的具体机制。这些思路对设计网络/设备分布式的低延迟安全推理或需要跨资源协调的MPC运行时（例如需要将状态从一个执行实体安全地迁移到另一个实体以避免重计算）具有潜在可迁移价值。注意：此结论仅基于题目与摘要。
deep_analysis.why_watch_en: The paper’s ideas—versioned state separation, cross-engine KV import, and finish-time-driven dispatch—are concrete mechanisms for dependency-aware scheduling, pipeline parallelism, and latency hiding. These mechanisms could transfer to designing distributed/ network-aware low-latency secure inference runtimes or MPC runtimes that need to move or reuse state across execution entities to avoid recomputation. Note: this assessment is based only on title and abstract.
deep_analysis.direct_relation_zh: 间接相关：不涉及安全MPC的密码协议，但与“运行时调度”“依赖感知/有状态DAG调度”“批处理/首令牌延迟优化”“流水线执行/延迟隐藏”等主题高度相关。对研究如何减少跨设备重计算、合并/重排有状态操作、以及选择合适执行引擎很有参考价值。
deep_analysis.direct_relation_en: Indirectly related: The work does not address cryptographic MPC protocols but is highly relevant to runtime scheduling, dependency-aware/stateful DAG scheduling, batching/first-token latency optimization, pipeline execution and latency hiding. It is useful for thinking about reducing recomputation across devices, reordering/fusing stateful operations, and engine selection for secure inference runtimes.
transferable_mechanisms_zh: 版本化流上下文与本地KV分离（便于状态迁移/重建）。
跨引擎KV导入以避免前缀重算（延迟优化）。
状态感知调度：基于预计完成时间分派请求以优化响应时长。
并行执行模式设计：Stateful Streaming与Concurrent Sequence模型。
为并发有状态流提供可验证的串行语义（固定发布版本）。
transferable_mechanisms_en: Versioned stream-context separation from engine-local KV (enables state migration/reconstruction).
Cross-engine KV import to avoid prefix recomputation (first-token latency optimization).
State-aware dispatch: assign requests by expected completion time to minimize latency.
Parallel execution modes for stateful streams: Stateful Streaming and Concurrent Sequence.
Read-fixed-version semantics to ensure responses match a serial reference.
deep_analysis.potential_overlap_zh: 与“网络/设备感知运行时”“依赖/关键路径调度”“流水线并行”“批处理与合并轮次（round coalescing）”等研究主题存在实用机制上的重叠。
deep_analysis.potential_overlap_en: There is practical overlap with network/device-aware runtimes, dependency/critical-path scheduling, pipeline parallelism, and batching/round coalescing research topics.
deep_analysis.potential_conflict_zh: 在MPC或隐私严格的场景下，跨引擎导入状态涉及状态暴露或密钥/秘密材料的传输，可能与安全/机密性要求冲突。摘要未说明状态迁移的安全或隔离保证，因此在安全敏感工作中使用需谨慎。
deep_analysis.potential_conflict_en: In MPC or privacy-sensitive settings, cross-engine state import may expose state or require moving keys/secret material, conflicting with confidentiality requirements. The abstract does not state security properties of state transfer, so applying these mechanisms in secure settings requires careful adaptation.

如何估计‘预计完成时间’：是否有代价模型或在线学习器？预测错误的鲁棒性如何？

How is the ‘expected finish time’ estimated—using analytic cost models, heuristics, or online learning? How robust are mispredictions?

对不同流量（帧率、并发流数）与不同模型大小下评估吞吐与尾延迟。

测量预测完成时间模块的准确度与错误对系统性能影响。
experiment_checks_en: Reproduce baselines: single-engine (with context reuse) vs parallel engines without shared state on the same SoCs and verify throughput/latency metrics.
Validate the claimed 4.6× reduction in first-token latency from cross-engine KV import by measuring import time, serialization overhead and bandwidth usage.
Evaluate throughput and tail latency under varying stream rates, concurrent streams and model sizes.
Test correctness of versioned contexts: verify responses match a serial reference under concurrent execution.
Measure accuracy of the expected-finish-time predictor and quantify performance degradation when it mispredicts.
tracking_targets: prediction accuracy for expected finish time
next_steps_zh: 阅读论文正文以获取KV导入细节与预测模型实现，并评估如何在保密设置下安全迁移状态（例如使用密文-可迁移格式或MPC/TEE）。
将版本化上下文与基于延迟模型的调度思想移植到MPC/安全推理运行时：研究如何在不泄露秘密的前提下重用/导入状态。
构建小规模原型以测量在分布式多主机（有网络延迟）环境下的收益，关注网络带宽与RPC批处理。
探索将‘读取固定版本以保持串行语义’的设计用于并发安全推理场景，以保证可验证一致性。
next_steps_en: Read the full paper for KV-import implementation and predictor details, and assess how to securely migrate state (e.g., encrypted transferable formats or use of MPC/TEE).
Adapt versioned-context and finish-time-driven dispatch ideas to MPC/secure inference runtimes—study methods to reuse/import state without leaking secrets.
Prototype in a distributed multi-host environment to measure benefits under network latency, focusing on RPC batching and bandwidth.
Investigate using fixed-version reads to provide verifiable serializability guarantees in concurrent secure inference.

paper.title: Governing Enterprise AI Traffic at Scale: Design and Operation of a Policy-Driven, Multi-Vendor LLM Gateway on Envoy
paper.abstract: Large organizations consume large language models (LLMs) from several vendors at once, each with its own API dialect, credential model, streaming protocol and pricing. Integrated directly, this heterogeneity yields credential sprawl, format lock-in, unbounded spend and inconsistent governance. We present the design and production operation of the Cosmos LLM Gateway, the governed entry point for enterprise LLM traffic at PayPal. Built on Envoy, it splits work by latency profile: I/O-bound control decisions (authentication, credential brokering, policy and budget evaluation) run in an out-of-process external-processing service, while wire-format translation, token metering and prompt-cache shaping run in-proxy as a Rust WebAssembly filter, so that, by default, streamed response body chunks never wait on an out-of-process call. Models, providers and prices are largely validated data rather than code. Governance is declarative policy evaluated by Open Policy Agent and managed through a control plane with role-scoped authoring, approvals, pilots, shadow-mode rollout, usage notifications and versioned policy bundles. For use cases that require it, a data-loss-prevention layer can block, redact or pseudonymize detected sensitive content before it reaches a provider. Spend scopes are views over per-model usage counters, so a new budget applies to spend already recorded in its window without migration. As of September 2026, the gateway serves more than 12,000 developers and hundreds of business use cases, handling roughly 200 billion tokens per day across more than 100 models at 99.999% availability to business. In a benchmark of the core request path against a synthetic upstream, it adds a median of 4 ms and a p99 of 11 ms of overhead at more than 2,200 requests per second on two 4-vCPU instances. We report the architecture, policy model, evaluation and lessons learned.

screening.short_summary_zh: 基于标题与摘要：本文描述了PayPal在生产环境中部署的Cosmos LLM Gateway的设计与运行经验。该网关基于Envoy，将控制决策（认证、凭证、策略、预算评估）放在外部进程，而用Rust WebAssembly过滤器在代理内进行线框翻译、计量和提示缓存，以保证流式响应块通常不等待外部处理。治理由Open Policy Agent驱动，提供基于角色的策略管理、试点与分阶段放量等。还支持DLP层。摘要称在生产规模（200B token/day）下高可用并展示了低延迟开销基准。以上均基于标题与摘要。
screening.short_summary_en: Title/abstract-based summary: the paper presents design and production operation of PayPal's Cosmos LLM Gateway built on Envoy. It separates latency-sensitive I/O (auth, credential brokering, policy, budgeting) into an out-of-process external processor while doing wire-format translation, token metering and prompt-cache shaping in-proxy as a Rust WASM filter so streamed chunks normally don't wait. Governance uses OPA and a control plane; optional DLP; reports 99.999% availability and small latency overheads at large scale. Summary relies only on title+abstract.
screening.why_interesting_zh: 直接相关：这是一个网络/运行时层面的工程化系统处理多供应商LLM接入、策略与预算控制，涉及协议翻译、流式响应延迟最小化、治理与预算计量等问题，对研究安全、性能与治理如何在同一运行时并存有直接参考价值。
screening.why_interesting_en: Highly relevant: describes a production gateway that balances latency, policy enforcement, multi-vendor protocol heterogeneity, and billing—topics relevant to secure LLM inference, runtime protocol selection, and network-aware systems. The paper gives concrete engineering patterns for low-latency policy-driven LLM routing. Analysis is title/abstract-based.
screening.relation_to_my_work_zh: 若你的研究聚焦于安全/隐私地服务化LLMs、网络层的策略执行、或MPC风格的多-provider orchestration，这篇工业经验论文提供可参考的 runtime 分层、延迟隔离与治理构建块。
screening.relation_to_my_work_en: Directly applicable if you study secure/managed LLM inference, gateway-level protocol selection, or network-aware runtime design. The separation of in-proxy low-latency path and out-of-process policy evaluation is a pattern potentially useful for MPC orchestration or hybrid deployments.
screening.possible_transfer_zh: 架构模式（代理内流式低延迟路径 + 外部策略服务）、基于角色的策略控制面、按token记量与预算范围等可直接借鉴到多协议/多后端受管的安全推理服务或隐私护航的MPC网关设计。
screening.possible_transfer_en: Architectural lessons—inline low-latency processing via WASM filters, OPA-driven declarative governance, credential brokering, and per-model budgeting—are transferable to managed secure-inference gateways or hybrid MPC/remote-provider orchestrators.
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_zh: 若你在MPC上下文实现类似的 gateway，需注意该论文是工程经验报告，可能缺乏可证明的安全/隐私保证；工作可能互补而非冲突。
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_en: If designing an MPC gateway, expect complementarity rather than conflict; this is an engineering/ops design and not a cryptographic-security proof. Verify assumptions when adapting to privacy-preserving execution.

How is the external policy service architected for low latency and high availability (fault tolerance, caching, batching strategies)?
Do they provide open-source components, config examples, or reproducible benchmarks?
How does the DLP layer handle end-to-end encryption and privacy requirements when proxying inputs to third-party providers?

deep_analysis.research_problem_zh: （仅基于题目与摘要）如何在企业级规模治理多供应商LLM调用的异构生态（不同API方言、凭证模式、流式协议、定价）下，既保证低延迟流式传输，又能实现集中化的策略、预算与数据泄露防护？
deep_analysis.research_problem_en: (Based only on title and abstract) How to govern enterprise-scale multi-vendor LLM traffic—each with different API dialects, credential models, streaming protocols and pricing—while achieving low-latency streaming, centralized policy/budget control, credential brokering and optional DLP.
deep_analysis.core_method_zh: 基于Envoy构建统一网关（Cosmos LLM Gateway）：将I/O绑定的控制决策（鉴权、凭证中介、策略/预算评估）放在外部处理服务中运行，而将线格式转换、令牌计量和提示缓存整形放在代理内通过Rust WebAssembly过滤器就地执行，从而避免流式响应块等待外部调用。策略使用声明式数据并由Open Policy Agent评估，控制面提供版本化策略包、试验与放量机制；可选的数据泄露防护层在发送给上游前阻断/编辑/匿名化敏感内容。
deep_analysis.core_method_en: An Envoy-based LLM gateway (Cosmos) that splits work by latency profile: I/O-bound control (auth, credential brokering, policy and budget evaluation) runs out-of-process as an external-processing service, while wire-format translation, token metering and prompt-cache shaping run in-proxy as a Rust WebAssembly filter so streamed response chunks don't block on OOP calls. Policies are declarative and evaluated by OPA; a control plane manages versioned policy bundles, approvals, pilots, shadow rollouts, and usage/budget scopes. An optional DLP layer can block/redact/pseudonymize sensitive content before it is sent to providers.
contributions_zh: 系统化的网关架构来治理多供应商LLM流量，结合了外部处理与in-proxy Wasm以降低流式延迟。
将模型/供应商/价格等作为已验证的数据而非代码，并用OPA实现声明式策略评估与控制面管控（版本化策略、审批、灰度、通知）。
引入按延迟上下文划分的实现，使默认流式响应块避免等待外部进程调用。
工程化成果与运行数据：生产中为12k+开发者与数百业务用例提供服务，每日约2000亿tokens，99.999%可用性；在合成上游基准下核心路径中位延迟+4ms、p99+11ms。
报告了设计、评估与实运经验教训。
contributions_en: A gateway architecture that governs multi-vendor LLM traffic combining OOP control plane and in-proxy Wasm filter to minimize streaming latency.
Treat models/providers/prices as validated data and use declarative policy (OPA) with a control plane supporting versioned policies, approvals, pilots and shadow rollouts.
Implementation detail: token metering, prompt-cache shaping and wire-format translation run in-proxy to avoid blocking streamed chunks on external calls.
Production-scale engineering: serves 12k+ developers and hundreds of use cases, ~200B tokens/day, 99.999% availability; measured core-path overhead of median +4ms and p99 +11ms at high RPS.
deep_analysis.why_watch_zh: 对研究安全/受控的模型托管或托管多方/多模型推理的工作非常有价值，尤其是关于低延迟流式路径设计（in-proxy Wasm）、策略声明化与治理实践、预算/计量设计和DLP集成的工程经验。对需要在MPC或隐私保护推理场景中实现统一接入、计费与策略执行的系统设计有重要借鉴意义。注意：此结论仅基于题目与摘要。
deep_analysis.why_watch_en: Valuable for research on secure/governed model hosting or multi-model inference deployment—particularly the low-latency streaming path via in-proxy Wasm, declarative policy/governance model, budget/meters, and DLP integration. These engineering practices are relevant for orchestrating MPC or privacy-preserving inference at enterprise scale. Note: this assessment is based only on title and abstract.
deep_analysis.direct_relation_zh: 间接相关：与‘安全LLM推理部署’、‘运行时/网关中延迟敏感的流式处理’、‘策略驱动的访问/预算控制’、以及‘流式RPC的低开销实现’高度相关，但不直接涉及MPC协议本身。
deep_analysis.direct_relation_en: Indirectly related: Highly relevant to secure LLM inference deployments, latency-sensitive streaming runtimes/gateways, policy-driven access/budget control, and low-overhead streaming RPC implementations, but it does not address MPC protocols directly.
transferable_mechanisms_zh: 将控制平面逻辑放在外部进程而把延迟敏感路径放到代理内（in-proxy Wasm）以避免阻塞的设计。
声明式策略与OPA评估结合控制面的版本化策略发布与灰度机制。
凭证中介与预算计量（token metering）作为网关功能，以统一供应商差异。
可插拔DLP层在入/出站流上进行实时拦截/编辑/匿名化。
将模型/定价作为验证数据而非代码以简化治理与审计。
transferable_mechanisms_en: Split control-plane logic out-of-process and put latency-sensitive path in-proxy (Rust Wasm filter) to avoid blocking streamed chunks.
Declarative policy (OPA) combined with a control plane for versioned policy bundles, approvals, pilots and shadow rollouts.
Credential brokering and token metering in the gateway to normalize multi-vendor heterogeneity.
Pluggable DLP layer for real-time blocking/redaction/pseudonymization of sensitive data.
Treat models/pricing as validated data (not code) to ease governance and auditing.
deep_analysis.potential_overlap_zh: 与‘网络代理优化、流式RPC、令牌计量、控制平面工程化’等主题高度重合。对构建低延迟安全/合规的推理网关有直接参考价值。
deep_analysis.potential_overlap_en: Substantial overlap with work on proxy optimization, streaming RPCs, token metering, and control-plane engineering. Directly informative for building low-latency, compliant inference gateways.
deep_analysis.potential_conflict_zh: 在MPC或端到端加密场景下，网关对流量进行DLP或内容检查会破坏端到端机密性；因此需要在保密要求与集中治理之间权衡。摘要并未说明如何在强隐私场景中保证不可见性或不可篡改性。
deep_analysis.potential_conflict_en: For MPC or end-to-end encrypted use cases, gateway-side DLP/content inspection conflicts with end-to-end confidentiality; there's a trade-off between centralized governance and strong privacy. The abstract doesn't describe how to preserve confidentiality in such cases.

Evaluate latency and consistency of policy publish/rollback mechanisms during policy changes.

token metering accuracy and billing counters
CPU/memory usage of in-proxy Wasm filter
next_steps_zh: 阅读全文以了解实现细节，尤其是Wasm滤镜、外部处理接口与DLP实现。
评估是否能将类似网关用于MPC或隐私推理的编排：研究如何在不暴露明文的情形下实现计量与预算（例如凭证代理但不解密）。
实验性地在小规模环境中实现in-proxy轻量功能（Wasm）以量化对流式延迟的真实影响。
研究将策略评估与审计日志与安全证明（例如可证明的策略执行）结合的方法。
next_steps_en: Read the full paper for implementation details of the Wasm filter, external-processing interface, and DLP.

Investigate integrating policy evaluation/auditing with formal or provable execution guarantees.

paper.title: One Megakernel is Not Enough: Predicting Where to Cut for Streaming Inference
paper.abstract: We address a fundamental question: How far should kernel fusion extend and which boundaries are worth preserving? Unlike the general convention of using one monolith megakernel at lower batch sizes or supporting only a selective model component as megakernel and rest of the model as conventional graph, we show that the best configuration is a composition of multiple megakernels with no overlapping conventional graph component, or a fully conventional graph. We present a framework that selects megakernel regions in a streaming inference model from conventional-graph profiles and standalone kernel benchmarks, without running any candidate design end to end. It simulates each candidate's tile and event graphs to predict time to first output and selects the measured best design in all 13 combinations of model and batch size we tested. Across NH-TTS, Qwen3-TTS and Llama-1B, the best composition ranges from two to four megakernels to fully conventional execution and none is a single megakernel. We introduce four model categories (megakernel-stable/ receding/ advancing/ averse) that capture how a model's best megakernel composition changes with batch size. Using NH-TTS model on H100 NVL GPU, we demonstrate that preserving three specialized megakernels can improve both latency and throughput despite introducing additional kernel boundaries. At batch size 32, this design delivers 21.4% lower mean batch-p95 time to first audio (TTFA) and 28% higher throughput than the evaluated monolith megakernel. Against conventional TensorRT graph execution, it reduces engine-level mean batch TTFA p95 by 4.05x and increases throughput by 19.7%.

screening.short_summary_zh: 基于题名与摘要：作者研究流式推理中应该将哪些计算融合为“megakernel”并保留哪些边界，提出在不做端到端候选跑测的情况下从概要性能剖面与独立核基准预测最佳megakernel组合的框架。跨多种模型（NH-TTS、Qwen3-TTS、Llama-1B）与批次大小实验显示最佳配置是多个专用megakernel的组合或完全常规图，单一大megakernel并非始终最好；在H100上专门的多核融合能同时提升延迟和吞吐。
screening.short_summary_en: Based on title and abstract: the paper studies how far kernel fusion should go for streaming inference and which boundaries to preserve. It presents a framework that predicts best megakernel regions from conventional-graph profiles and kernel benchmarks without end-to-end runs. Evaluations across models and batch sizes show that best designs are often multiple megakernels or fully conventional graphs rather than a single monolith; preserving several specialized megakernels can reduce TTFA p95 and increase throughput significantly (per abstract).
screening.why_interesting_zh: 与MPC/secure inference编译器和运行时高度相关：选择在哪切分计算以平衡 kernel-launch 开销、数据传输、并行性和内存使用，与在MPC中做阶段分配、批处理与轮次合并问题有密切类比（基于题名與摘要）。
screening.why_interesting_en: Highly relevant to MPC compilers and runtimes: deciding where to cut/fuse operators to balance launch overhead, data movement, parallelism and memory mirrors choices in MPC stage placement, batch coalescing, and round coalescing. The predictive, non-end-to-end profiling approach is promising (title+abstract).
screening.relation_to_my_work_zh: 直接能启发MPC编译器（例如MP-SPDZ风格）的指令/阶段划分策略：通过模型化核与事件图来预测时间至首输出与吞吐，有望替代昂贵的端到端评估（基于题名與摘要）。
screening.relation_to_my_work_en: Directly applicable to MPC compiler/runtime: predictive selection of fused regions (megakernels) could inform stage partitioning, batching and coalescing decisions in secure inference pipelines, avoiding expensive end-to-end probing (title+abstract only).
screening.possible_transfer_zh: 可移植点包括：1) 用独立核基准与事件图模拟来预测合并边界，不必在每种划分下运行完整安全协议；2) 将megakernel分类概念（stable/aversive/etc.）用于自动化选择不同网络/带宽/轮次下的执行模式；3) 将TTFA预测作为延迟优化目标用于WAN-aware调度。
screening.possible_transfer_en: Transferable ideas: (1) use kernel-level benchmarks plus event/tile graph simulation to pick fusion/cut points without full end-to-end secure runs; (2) apply megakernel category heuristics to choose execution modes under different batch/network conditions; (3) use TTFA prediction as an objective for WAN-aware scheduling and round-coalescing in MPC. Requires mapping kernel costs to MPC cryptographic primitives and communication rounds.
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_zh: 与深度学习编译器/融合文献相近；在安全执行场景需谨慎，因为加密/通信语义可能改变最佳划分。
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_en: Related to compiler/kernel fusion literature; when porting to secure execution, cryptographic/communication semantics may change optimal fusion boundaries—no direct conflict in abstract.
questions_to_verify_zh: 候选设计的事件/瓷砖(tiled)图模拟对加密通信与同步点如何建模？
在带宽或高延迟网络（或MPC轮次成本）下，最佳megakernel组成如何变化？
该框架在多设备或异构设备（含NPU/TPU）上是否仍保持预测准确？
questions_to_verify_en: How does the event/tile graph simulation model cryptographic communication and sync-point costs?
How do optimal megakernel compositions shift under constrained bandwidth/high-latency (or MPC round-cost) conditions?
Does the predictor remain accurate across heterogeneous devices (including NPUs)?

deep_analysis.research_problem_zh: （仅基于题目与摘要）在流式推理场景下，应当怎样划分/融合核函数（kernel fusion/megakernel）——即多少边界值得保留，哪些区域应作为megakernel——以同时优化首输出时间（time to first output, TTFO）和吞吐？特别是在不同批次与模型组件的组合下，单一的大型megakernel并非总优解。
deep_analysis.research_problem_en: (Based only on title and abstract) For streaming inference, how far should kernel fusion (megakernelization) extend and which kernel boundaries should be preserved to optimize both time-to-first-output (TTFO) and throughput across models and batch sizes—showing that multiple megakernels or a fully conventional graph may outperform a single monolith megakernel.
deep_analysis.core_method_zh: 提出一个从常规图剖面与独立内核基准出发、无需端到端候选运行的框架：模拟每个候选设计的tile与event图来预测首输出时间，并选择预测最优的megakernel组成。将模型按对megakernel行为相对批次变化划分为四类（megakernel-stable/recening/advancing/averse），并在多模型/多批次组合上做测评验证。
deep_analysis.core_method_en: A selection framework that, using conventional-graph profiles and standalone kernel benchmarks (without running full end-to-end candidates), simulates tile and event graphs for each candidate to predict time-to-first-output and selects the empirically best megakernel composition. Introduce four model categories describing how optimal megakernel composition changes with batch size and validate across multiple models and batches.
contributions_zh: 提出无需端到端运行即可从microbenchmark与图剖面预测TTFO的选择框架。
证明在多种模型与批次下最佳配置不是一个单独的megakernel，而是多个专用megakernel的组合或完全保留常规模型图。
给出模型的四类行为分类（megakernel-stable/receding/advancing/averse），用于理解与预测融合边界随批次变化的趋势。
在H100等硬件上的实证结果：在多个基准（NH-TTS、Qwen3-TTS、Llama-1B）上展示在保持额外边界的同时提升延迟与吞吐（示例：BS=32时，三段专用megakernel对NH-TTS的TTFA p95下降21.4%，吞吐提高28%）。
contributions_en: A framework that predicts TTFO from microbenchmarks and graph profiles without end-to-end runs.
Empirical finding that the best execution is often multiple megakernels (2–4) or fully conventional graph, not a single monolithic megakernel.
A four-class model taxonomy (megakernel-stable/receding/advancing/averse) describing how optimal fusion changes with batch size.
Empirical improvements on H100 across models (e.g., for NH-TTS at batch size 32, 21.4% lower mean batch p95 TTFO and 28% higher throughput versus monolith megakernel).
deep_analysis.why_watch_zh: 该工作在编译器決策与运行时调度中提供了用于权衡融合边界的可预测方法：模拟tile/event图以预测关键路径（首输出）与吞吐。这与MPC编译器中‘是否合并通信轮次/门融合’的抉择高度类比，能为round-coalescing、依赖感知指令重排与性能模型提供可迁移方法。注意：此结论仅基于题目与摘要。
deep_analysis.why_watch_en: This paper offers a predictive approach to decide fusion boundaries by simulating tile/event graphs to estimate critical-path TTFO and throughput—directly analogous to MPC compiler decisions about coalescing communication rounds or fusing operations. The method could transfer to round-coalescing, dependency-aware instruction scheduling, and performance modeling for secure runtimes. Note: this assessment is based only on title and abstract.
deep_analysis.direct_relation_zh: 较强的间接相关性：与“MPC编译器决策（是否合并轮次/门融合）”“关键路径/首输出优化”“依赖/事件图模拟”“流水线与批次权衡”等主题直接契合，可用于指导减少交互轮次或优化延迟。
deep_analysis.direct_relation_en: Strong indirect relevance: aligns with MPC compiler decisions (whether to coalesce rounds/gates), critical-path/TTFO optimization, dependency/event-graph simulation, and pipeline/batch trade-offs—applicable for reducing interaction rounds or optimizing latency in secure protocols.
transferable_mechanisms_zh: 用独立内核基准与图剖面构造的tile/event图模拟来预测端到端关键路径时间（TTFO）。
在候选设计空间中用轻量仿真替代端到端运行以快速筛选最优融合边界。
将模型行为按对融合边界敏感性分类，形成适应性策略（随批次调整）。
将TTFO作为首要指标纳入选择函数，而非仅以吞吐或单一延迟为准。
transferable_mechanisms_en: Predict end-to-end critical-path time (TTFO) by simulating tile/event graphs constructed from standalone kernel benchmarks and graph profiles.
Use lightweight simulation rather than full end-to-end runs to quickly search the fusion-design space.
Classify models by sensitivity to fusion boundaries and adopt adaptive strategies that change fusion with batch size.
Prioritize TTFO in the selection function instead of throughput-only or single-latency metrics.
deep_analysis.potential_overlap_zh: 与‘依赖感知调度、关键路径优化、round coalescing、编译器级融合策略’存在直接方法论上的重叠。
deep_analysis.potential_overlap_en: Direct methodological overlap with dependency-aware scheduling, critical-path optimization, round coalescing, and compiler-level fusion strategies.
deep_analysis.potential_conflict_zh: 在MPC/隐私场景下，合并更多算子或产生更大的“megakernel”可能导致更复杂的密钥/秘密管理、增加中间态暴露面，或影响并行化策略；因此需要考虑安全/泄露风险与记忆体约束。
deep_analysis.potential_conflict_en: In MPC/privacy settings, fusing more operators into larger megakernels may complicate key/secret management, increase exposure of intermediate state, or change parallelism strategies—introducing security and memory trade-offs to consider.

延迟/吞吐预测模型的误差范围如何？有无线上学习或自适应纠偏机制？

What is the error range of latency/throughput predictions? Is there online learning or adaptive correction for model mismatch?

与monolith megakernel与完全常规图的多维基线对比，复现实验中的TTFO p95/吞吐提升数据。
experiment_checks_en: Validate simulation predictions (TTFO and throughput) against end-to-end measurements across multiple models/batches/hardware and report error statistics.
Assess correctness and stability of the chosen fusion strategies across batch sizes.
Test behavior under constrained resources (memory, bandwidth) to ensure no OOMs or latency regressions.

所选融合策略随批次的变化比率

在不同硬件上的性能稳定性（TTFO/吞吐）
next_steps_zh: 阅读全文以获得tile/event图建模、预测器细节与自动化流程实现。
考虑将该选择框架的思想应用于MPC编译器：把‘通信轮次合并/分割’视为融合边界并用轻量模拟预测交互延迟和关键路径。
实现一个小规模原型，使用微基准模拟MPC门或子协议的执行时间，评估在真实网络延迟下的决策效用。
研究如何把安全约束（秘密共享/加密限制）纳入成本模型，使融合决策同时满足性能与安全要求。
next_steps_en: Read the full paper for tile/event graph modeling, predictor details and automation pipeline.
Apply the selection-framework idea to an MPC compiler: treat communication-round coalescing as fusion boundaries and use lightweight simulation to predict interaction-latency critical paths.
Prototype a small system that uses microbenchmarks of MPC gates/subprotocols to drive fusion/round-coalescing decisions and evaluate under real network latencies.
Explore incorporating security constraints (secret-sharing/encryption costs) into the cost model so fusion decisions respect both performance and confidentiality.

paper.title: WorldPager: Zero-Stall Tiered Memory for Long-Horizon World Models on a Single Consumer GPU
paper.abstract: Interactive world models keep the KV of past chunks as retrieval memory so that revisited places stay consistent. On a single consumer machine (one RTX 4090, 32 GiB of host memory, one NVMe SSD), long sessions with such memory hit two walls. The first is capacity: the KV of Matrix-Game 2.0 exhausts host memory after 45 seconds of video in bf16 and after 2.8 minutes in int4. The second is the model's positional horizon of 4.3 minutes. We show that this memory is capacity-bound rather than bandwidth-bound and that its access set is known before compute, because the camera pose is an input. An analytical model built on these observations predicts spill points to within one chunk and classifies zero versus non-zero stalls correctly on held-out configurations. Guided by it, WorldPager stores int4 KV in a GPU/DRAM/NVMe hierarchy instead of recomputing it, prefetches each chunk's memory from the extrapolated pose, never waits on a miss, and writes back in the background; to our knowledge, it is the first to place the KV memory of an interactive world model on an NVMe tier with zero-stall prefetching. With training-free position handling, it generates 37.5 minutes of video continuously with zero stalls and constant host memory, at about 9.5 frames per second. On a sealed test set, int4 storage shows no measurable quality loss; on long-gap revisits it lowers image quality by about one MUSIQ point.

screening.short_summary_zh: 基于标题与摘要：WorldPager针对单台消费者GPU上交互式世界模型（KV记忆）遇到的主机内存容量瓶颈和位置相关访问可预测性问题，提出将int4 KV存放在GPU/DRAM/NVMe层次并基于可预测的摄像机位姿提前预取，做到零停顿（zero-stall）并在后台写回。该方法不需要训练即可处理位置，实现在单张RTX4090上连续生成37.5分钟视频零停顿。摘要信息仅基于标题与摘要。
screening.short_summary_en: Title/abstract-based summary: WorldPager observes KV memory for interactive world models is capacity-bound and access sets are known from input poses. It places int4 KV on a GPU/DRAM/NVMe hierarchy, prefetches chunks based on extrapolated poses, and performs background writeback to achieve zero-stall prefetching. Claims 37.5 minutes continuous generation on one consumer GPU with constant host memory and no measurable quality loss for int4. Summary is based only on the abstract/title.
screening.why_interesting_zh: 与MPC主题直接无关，但从运行时与调度角度高度相关：它是一个基于已知访问集做静态/预测预取以避免 stalls 的系统，对于依赖已知依赖图（DAG）和访问可预测性的网络/分布式MPC任务调度有启发意义。
screening.why_interesting_en: Not MPC per se, but highly relevant to runtime scheduling: it demonstrates using known future access patterns to schedule prefetching across a memory hierarchy to eliminate stalls—techniques analogous to dependency-aware scheduling, batching, and zero-wait execution in distributed runtimes and MPC pipelines.
screening.relation_to_my_work_zh: 如果你的研究涉及依赖可预测的访问模式（例如由摄像头/传感器驱动的输入）来提前安排MPC子协议、分割KV或预加载秘密共享数据，这篇工作提供可借鉴的工程模式与分析方法（容量模型与溢出预测）。
screening.relation_to_my_work_en: If you schedule MPC subprotocols or manage secret-shared state with predictable future access, WorldPager's analytic spill-point model and prefetch/writeback design are useful analogies for designing zero-wait prefetching and hierarchical storage strategies.
screening.possible_transfer_zh: 预测驱动的预取策略、容量溢出建模和分层存储管理可直接迁移到需要跨GPU/主机/磁盘管理大状态的隐私/安全推理系统，以减少延迟与IO阻塞。
screening.possible_transfer_en: Predictive prefetching, spill-point modeling, and tiered storage management can transfer to systems that must manage large state across GPU/host/disk (e.g., large MPC state or secret-shared KV caches) to avoid runtime stalls and improve throughput.
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_zh: 与已有的分层缓存/预取研究方法学上互补；没有明显冲突。
screening.possible_overlap_or_conflict_en: Complementary to prior tiered-caching and prefetching research; no clear conflict. Verify novelty claims in context of prior prefetching/SSD-backed caching work.
questions_to_verify_zh: 溢出/预取的解析模型具体形式是什么，如何预测访问集合并将其映射为prefetch计划？
在非平稳或高不确定位姿估计下，预取错误率与回退策略如何设计？
对不同NVMe速度、主机内存限制与其他模型精度（int4->int8）敏感性如何量化？
questions_to_verify_en: What is the exact analytical spill-point model and how are future access sets predicted and turned into prefetch schedules?
How robust is the prefetching to pose prediction errors or non-stationary revisits; what fallback strategies exist for mispredictions?
How sensitive are results to NVMe performance, host memory caps, and quantization choices (int4 vs int8)?
